materials.component: Zig standard library used by Injector 0.11.0
materials.basis: Injector v0.11.0 zig-version pins 0.15.2; build.zig.zon declares no external packages and build.zig disables libc.
Vendored include/spdlog/version.h identifies 1.15.3 and its source headers declare MIT.

materials.component: .NET Foundation MIT text for copied native CoreCLR headers
materials.basis: The copied lib/coreclr/src/inc/cor.h in instrumentation v1.17.0 declares .NET Foundation MIT. The license text source is not a claim that the vendored CoreCLR code is v10.0.0.

materials.component: GNU runtime license text for static libgcc/libstdc++
materials.basis: Instrumentation v1.17.0 native CMake uses -static-libgcc and -static-libstdc++; exact compiler/runtime build versions remain unverified.
License text only: this does not certify eligible compilation or pin the actual bundled GNU runtime version.
